responsibility: Provides the target macros, ABI definitions, register numbering, storage-layout rules, calling-convention types, assembler/linker specs, address-space identifiers, and hook macro bindings that configure GCC for the R8C/M16C/M32C family. It is the central target header that describes pointer sizes, stack/frame conventions, register names and eliminations, function argument state, section output, and the bridge from generic GCC macros to M32C-specific helpers implemented in m32c.cc.
same_name_distinction: Configuration header for the m32c port, distinct from the executable logic in m32c.cc, the RTL pattern definitions in m32c.md, and the command-line option declarations in m32c.opt; it chiefly declares target macros, data layouts, register numbers, and macro-to-function bindings used by the backend.
